g.text: Scenario 2: Player Turn — Warrior Defends Against Goblin's Next Attack
Turn order (SpeedBasedTurnOrder): Warrior SPD=30 acts before Goblin SPD=25.
Scenarios 2 and 3 are part of the same executePlayerTurn() call.
This diagram covers the Warrior (player) phase.
User sees the action bar rendered
Goblin (Enemy) phase follows next in the same loop.
See Scenario 3 for the enemy phase detail.
